page_title: StarUML – A sophisticated software modeler for agile and concise modeling

summary.name: StarUML
summary.one_liner: StarUML is a software modeling tool for building UML, SysML, BPMN, ERD, C4, flowchart and other diagrams, with JavaScript extensions and MCP-based AI integration.
keywords: open source alternative to enterprise architect
use_cases: drawing UML class and sequence diagrams
documenting software architecture with C4 diagrams
summary.what_it_does: StarUML supports most UML 2 diagram types, plus ERD, data flow, flowchart, mindmap, C4, SysML, BPMN, UI wireframe, and AWS, GCP and Azure architecture diagrams, and multiple languages can be mixed in one project. Model data is stored in a simple JSON format that can be used with a command-line interface to generate code, docs, and images. Code generation for Java, C#, C++ and Python is available via open source extensions. The tool can be extended with JavaScript, and it offers Mermaid syntax diagram creation, an MCP server for AI integration, Markdown documentation editing, HTML doc publishing, and PDF export. The page also promotes Frame0, a separate wireframing product.
notable: Supports UML 2, ERD, SysML, BPMN, C4 and more in a single project
Model data stored as simple JSON with CLI-driven generation
Hackable with JavaScript extensions and MCP server for AI integration
Mermaid syntax support for text-to-diagram creation
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Code generation for some languages depends on open source extensions
Frame0 wireframing is a separate product promoted on the page
